All tests pass.

Added a `habit remind` command: it lists any habits not yet marked done today (or "All habits done for today!" if none pending), following the same `commands.js`/`cli.js` split as the rest of the CLI. Tests added in `test/commands.test.js`.

This is an on-demand check, not a proactive push notification — "reminders" could mean several things, so I built the smallest uncontroversial piece. Options if you want it to nag you automatically:
1. Cron job running `habit remind` on a schedule (no new deps, just a crontab entry outside this repo).
2. OS desktop notifications (would need a new dependency or shell-out to `notify-send`/`osascript`).
3. `done`/`list` could print the same reminder text automatically when habits are pending.

Recommendation: option 1 (cron + this new command) — keeps the CLI dependency-free and lets you pick your own schedule.
